info.title: AttOs Game Dashboard Web Session API
info.summary: Manual contract for the Dioxus Dashboard UI and cookie-authenticated web session API.
info.description:
This contract documents the implemented Dashboard routes. It is a web-session API only: no PAT, OAuth scope, bearer token, or external-client API is provided. The Dioxus build may serve hashed files under /assets as browser-internal static assets, but those generated filenames are not stable API operations.

Production HoYoLAB owner binding and reward posting remain hard-gated off until the upstream contracts are separately proven; affected operations return 503/unavailable instead of using synthetic bypasses.

attosSessionCookie.description: HttpOnly SameSite=Strict session cookie. HTTPS deployments use __Host-attos_session with Secure; localhost HTTP uses attos_session.

message.description: Sanitized static or numeric diagnostic; never includes secrets or raw upstream messages.

verification_available.description: False in production until upstream owner binding is separately approved.

reward_posting_available.description: False in production until reward POST contract is separately approved.

confirmation.description: Exact target username typed by the actor.

WebAuthnOptions.description: Opaque WebAuthn options object returned by webauthn-rs. The browser-facing UI converts base64url fields before calling navigator.credentials.

WebAuthnCredentialResponse.description: Browser PublicKeyCredential JSON wrapper as produced by the Dioxus web-sys/js-sys WebAuthn bridge; fields are intentionally not hand-expanded.
